Position Overview CLO Virtual Fashion에서 3D Design & Implementation Specialist를 채용합니다. [안내] 본 포지션은 패션 산업(브랜드, 벤더 등)에서 4-6년의 실무 경험을 갖춘 분들을 위한 채용입니다. CLO 소프트웨어의 기존 숙련도는 요구하지 않으며, 입사 후 새로운 IT 기술을 빠르게 습득하여 기존 패션 실무 지식과 결합할 수 있는 역량(Tech Savviness)을 중점적으로 평가합니다. CLO의 3D Design & Implementation Specialist는 CLO 소프트웨어 전문가로서 패션/디자인/패턴에 관한 지식을 바탕으로 CLO 유저를 교육하고 서포트하는 역할을 수행합니다. 아울러, 유저의 니즈를 가장 먼저 이해하여 3D 프로세스가 효과적으로 접목될 수 있도록 전문적인 컨설팅을 진행합니다. 이처럼 CLO의 3D Design & Implementation Specialist는 유저가 CLO를 더 효율적이고 가치있게 사용할 수 있도록 컨설팅, 교육, 서포트하는 역할을 수행합니다. Hiring Process [서류 검토] → [1차 인터뷰] → [CLO Software Test] → [2차 인터뷰 (+Reference Check)] → [처우 협의] → [최종 합격] (1차 인터뷰 합격자에게는 2차 면접 전, CLO 사전 학습용 교육 자료 및 임시 라이선스가 제공됩니다. 2차 면접 시 진행되는 테스트는 기존의 CLO 숙련도가 아닌, 새로운 소프트웨어를 빠르게 습득하는 학습 능력과 패션 구조에 대한 이해도를 평가하기 위한 과정입니다.) To Apply 이력서 및 경력기술서 1부 (필수) 지원동기가 담긴 자기소개서 (필수) 본인의 담당 업무 및 참여 프로젝트가 기술된 포트폴리오 (선택) (CLO를 직접 다룬 경험이 없더라도, 참여하신 프로젝트 및 업무 경력을 확인하기 위해 포트폴리오 제출을 권장합니다.)

jobs.title: Brand Communications Manager
jobs.description_text: About Us CLO Virtual Fashion is the industry-leading provider of innovative 3D products and ecosystem solutions used in fashion, film, and gaming. With over two decades of research and development in true-to-life 3D garment simulation, CLO Virtual Fashion's mission is to empower users at every step of the garment journey, from concept to design, manufacturing to marketing, and fitting to styling. In addition to 3D garment design software (CLO & Marvelous Designer), CLO Virtual Fashion is the creator of CLO-SET (a digital asset management and collaboration platform), CONNECT (a digital fashion hub and marketplace), and consumer-facing solutions such as e-commerce virtual fittings. jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the Role Sourcing is where the money is actually decided. We are expanding our Data Capture Research team in Prague with a Senior Data Scientist to work on Sourcing. Which suppliers get invited. How the event is structured. How bids that differ in price, lead time, quality, risk and carbon get compared at all. What a fair price even is. When to award, to whom, and how to split the award across suppliers. For a researcher this is unusually open ground - not one model family, but several, on the same data: Recommendation and retrieval. Supplier discovery: matching demand to the right suppliers across a 10M-node network. Forecasting and should-cost modelling. What this category, in this region, at this volume, should cost right now. Game theory and mechanism design. Auction formats, bidding behaviour, incentives, and competitive dynamics between real counterparties. Combinatorial optimisation. Award allocation under volume, capacity and multi-sourcing constraints. Multimodal document understanding. RFPs, specs, quotes and contracts carry the actual requirements - and our T-LLM foundations already give us a head start there. Part of the work is choosing the right instrument for each - neural networks, gradient boosting, optimisation, bandits, mechanism design - instead of forcing one. jobs.title: Sr AI Engineer
jobs.description_text: About The Team Rossum joined Coupa earlier this year. We brought the document understanding layer - our proprietary T-LLM (transactional LLM) architectures, which we design and train from scratch, and which read the world's messiest business documents in production, millions of them every week. Now we are pointing the same in-house research capability at a much bigger problem: not just reading the documents, but acting on them. About the Role Sourcing is where the money is actually decided. We are expanding our AI Platform team in Prague with a Senior AI Platform Engineer to work on a Sourcing problem set – which suppliers get invited. How the event is structured. How bids that differ in price, lead time, quality, risk and carbon get compared at all. What a fair price even is. When to award, to whom, and how to split the award across suppliers.
